git_intro: Inspect the commit identity and configuration sources for this repository.
ssh_intro: Inspect host settings and key references for the SSH client Git would use.
identity_help: Commit identity is separate from the account used to authenticate. Values apply to this Git executable and process environment.
shared_git_directory: Shared repository configuration: {{path}}. Local edits may affect sibling worktrees.
unset: Unset — Git may infer a value outside configuration
condition_help: Supported: hasconfig:remote.*.url:, gitdir:, gitdir/i:. The exact pattern below is written.
remote_unsupported: This Git does not support remote URL rules. Use gitdir: or gitdir/i:.
ssh_evidence: These are configuration references; they do not prove successful authentication. Private key contents are never read.
trust_help: Git refused to read local configuration. Review the reported ownership, then copy and run this command yourself if you trust this repository. Whichcraft does not change safe.directory.
recovery_heading: An interrupted configuration operation needs review
recovery_help: Current content was inspected without overwriting it. Before means unchanged; after means the write is present; unexpected needs manual inspection.
helper_reset: Explicitly empty — resets accumulated credential helpers
inspect_ssh: Inspect SSH host and key references
